What's New in Shale 1.0.136
Draft generated from commit messages since Shale 1.0.135. Review and edit before publishing.

New
• Added task due date policy (none, warn, require)
• Added Stay Logged In feature to login screen
• Added phone and email format requirements
• Added universal search suggestions and scoped recent history

Improvements
• Allow all users to configure automatic updates
• Place case date confirmation below value
• Show selected Case Date type card
• Optimize user management loading and dark theme contrast
• Complete audited task policy administration
• Redesign desktop login experience
• Validate phone and email values across intake, profiles and APIs

Fixes
• Fix case date confirmation row layout
• Fix Case Calendar dark theme cards
• Fix case content pane horizontal growth
• Fix Case Date card text contrast
• Corrected sql calls
• Fix login FXML preferred sizing constants
• Fix remembered sign-in lifecycle diagnostics
• Fix remembered session SQL context and diagnostics
• Fix intake phone feedback and layout; accept explicit US local numbers
• Fix SQL Server suggestion pattern declarations and Unicode bindings
